paper.title: Neural Contextual Bandits with Deep Representation and Shallow Exploration

settings.name_in_paper: Neural contextual bandit (reward r(.) = <theta*, psi(.)>, unknown feature mapping)
unmapped: reward generating function r is arbitrary (values in (0,1)); approximated by a deep ReLU network, regret bound depends on NTK-norm of approximation error ||r - r_tilde||_{H^{-1}}
regret conditioned on random network initialization
settings.definition_quote: At each round t=1,...,T, the agent first observes a context s_t chosen by the environment; then it needs to adaptively select an arm a_t based on its past observations; finally it receives a reward \hat{r}_t(x_{s,a_t})=r(x_{s,a_t})+\xi_t ... we assume that the reward generating function r(\cdot) can be expressed as ... r(\cdot)=\la\btheta^*,\bpsi(\cdot)\ra ... \xi_t is an independent \nu-subGaussian random noise

symbols.H_buf: retraining period (epoch length H) of the network
symbols.G: bound on the norm of the learned features phi(x; w)
symbols.L_layers: number of hidden layers of the network
symbols.E_err: ||r - r_tilde||_{H^{-1}}, NTK-norm of the error between true rewards and network outputs

conditions: Assumption 2: first-order stability of network gradient w.r.t. inputs with constant l_Lip
Assumption 3: NTK matrix H has lambda_min(H) >= lambda_0 > 0
tuning: alpha_t = nu*sqrt(2(d log(1+t log(HK)/lambda) + log(1/delta))) + lambda^{1/2} M
eta_q <= C_0 (d^2 m n T^{5.5} L^6 log(TK/delta))^{-1}

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions 1, 2 and 3 hold. Assume that $\|\btheta^*\|_2\leq M$ ... With probability at least $1-\delta$ over the randomness of the initialization of the neural network, it holds that R_T\leq C_1\alpha_T\sqrt{Td\log(1+ \frac{TG^2}{\lambda d})}+\frac{C_2\fosPara L^3 d^{5/2}T\sqrt{\log m\log(1/\delta)\log(TK/\delta)}\|\rb-\tilde\rb\|_{\Hb^{-1}}}{m^{1/6}}

results.notes: Regret is expectation over reward noise conditional on random initialization; the bound holds w.p. 1-delta over initialization. alpha_T substituted from its definition (nu -> sigma, M -> S). G is not formally defined in the theorem. Remark 6: if E_err = O(1) and m >= T^3, regret is O_tilde(sqrt(T)). Environment for contexts is unspecified (contexts chosen by the environment).
